scope: Independent numerical and scientific claim review of final report source and presentation notes; no grade guarantee or new model inference.

rubric_coverage_without_grade_prediction.evidence: Loaded 1,295 images; split/class counts, RGB dimensions, no corrupt/exact duplicates and 14 screened pairs including seven cross-split pairs match audit files. Expert source labels are distinguished from AI duplicate screening; missing farm/plant identities and unknown pretraining overlap are disclosed.

Concrete accessible SigLIP2 checkpoint, native bilinear preprocessing, frozen pretrained attention pooler and partial gradients are accurate. DINO full-image resize override is explicit. Loaded parameter counts and adaptation settings match run metadata; the model-family comparison is not represented as a causal age/architecture experiment.

All four configuration means/sample SDs, raw mean training times, majority baseline, paired-seed differences, reference bootstrap, clean split means/gaps, class errors, harm-type counts, highest wrong confidence and stress scores match independently recomputed artifacts. The bootstrap concerns seed 17, not the three-seed mean. Later loss deterioration and selected-checkpoint caveats are supported by history files.

The report connects error types to plausible agricultural harms without claiming measured deployment outcomes; covers restricted classes, uncalibrated confidence, geographic/farmer/device fairness limits, referral/expert oversight, consent/privacy, licences/attribution, environmental limitations and AI assistance.

Text contains completed results and no placeholders; conclusion accurately reports stronger frozen SigLIP features and effectively tied partial means with smaller DINOv2 parameter/memory costs. References and experimental limitations are explicit. This content review does not certify PDF layout; visual review is separate.

rounding: DINOv2 frozen accuracy is exactly 90.625%; 90.62 uses ties-to-even formatting consistently. 90.63 would also be defensible under half-up formatting. This has no scientific effect.

primary_paper_fact_checked.claim: Table 1 B/16 at 224 resolution reports ImageNet zero-shot accuracy 78.2 for SigLIP2 versus 76.2 for original SigLIP; the specified same-size comparison supports recent-model selection without a Beans SOTA claim.

interpretation: No consistent partial-model advantage is established across three seeds. These are exploratory results on a previously evaluated small test set. Observed laptop timing retains unexplained long durations and is not a controlled hardware benchmark.
remaining_limits: No external farm-level validation or pretraining-overlap measurement.
Unknown plant/farm dependence is not corrected by the paired image bootstrap.
No fresh confirmatory claim, deployment certification or grade guarantee.
Full Colab training was not executed; presentation notes disclose local execution.
